title: VIXEN CodegenTool cache materialization passed a slashless output directory
body: The VIXEN CMake cache builder passed an output directory without a trailing separator, while SourceGenerator~/SDFNodeGenerator.csproj deploys its analyzer by concatenating OutputPath with AssemblyName. The cached build then looked for binSDFNodeGenerator.dll and failed before FrameTargets schema regeneration. Workaround applied in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt: append a trailing slash to the output directory. Suggested consolidation: normalize output-directory separators in the shared VixenBuildCodegen/materializer path or change analyzer deployment to use Path.Combine.
